newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-STATE TO SELL RAIL, GAS, ENERGY COMPANIES.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-STATE TO SELL RAIL, GAS, ENERGY COMPANIES.

text.p: Lithuanian European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene said on Thursday the government had agreed to add the state-owned railroad, gas and energy companies to its list of companies to be privatised.
Andrikiene told Reuters in an interview that proposals to sell the gas, energy and railway companies from parliament's economics committee have been approved by parliament.
"They also made the new proposals to include in this list Lithuania railway, Lithuanian gas and Lithuania energy, so those are three additional enterprises to be included," she added.

Lithuania's right-wing government has vowed to speed privatisation and attract more foreign investors. It has already said it would sell stakes in several key firms, including over 50 percent of Lithuania's airline and the state telecom.
It has failed to attract the same levels of foreign investments as its Baltic cousins Latvia and Estonia and is keen to change its image as a regional laggard.
